assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original architectural ceramic art tile face for a luxury interior materials website hero, square 1024 by 1024.
Primary request: create one stunning full-bleed warm dusty terracotta sculptural ceramic relief surface. Asymmetrical nested circular arcs meet a broad half-disc and restrained incised straight lines. Sophisticated Bauhaus-adjacent architectural geometry; minimal balanced design with a strong focal sweep and generous calm areas.
Composition/framing: perfectly front-on orthographic flat square tile face, filling every edge of the entire square image. The ceramic surface must reach all four image edges, no visible perimeter or tile thickness, no perspective.
Lighting/mood: soft upper-left studio light makes shallow relief dimensional, exceptional fine clarity and understated premium elegance.
Color palette: tonal warm dusty terracotta clay, muted and sophisticated, no bright orange.
Materials/textures: sanded matte ceramic with authentic very fine clay grain and carefully sculpted shallow relief, restrained precise grooves.
Constraints: one unified square art-tile surface, no surrounding background, no border, no mockup, no angled tile, no cast shadow outside, no text, no logo, no watermark, no props, no scenery, no collage or contact sheet. CSS will supply the tile shape, physical edge and shadow; generate only the full-bleed front surface artwork.
